review_basis: Human visual review of rendered vector PDF sheets M8.3, M8.6, and M8.8 plus negative-control sheet M8.5. Expectations describe authored drawing evidence, not current engine output.

expected_sequences.title: CHILLED WATER SYSTEM - SEQUENCE OF OPERATION
required_phrases: THE CHILLED WATER SYSTEM SHALL CONSIST OF A SINGLE AIR COOLED CHILLER AND TWO VARIABLE PRIMARY CHILLED WATER PUMPS
THE BMS MODULATES THE DUTY CHILLED WATER PUMP TO MAINTAIN DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE
THE CHILLED WATER BYPASS VALVE SHALL BE NORMALLY CLOSED

expected_sequences.title: AHU - 1 SEQUENCE OF OPERATIONS
required_phrases: THE SUPPLY AIR FANS ARE INTENDED TO OPERATE INDEPENDENT OF EACH OTHER
AN OPTIMAL START ROUTINE SHALL BE UTILIZED
DUCT STATIC PRESSURE RESET

expected_sequences.title: LEED IAQ PRE - OCCUPANCY FLUSH - OUT - SEQUENCE OF OPERATION
required_phrases: THE AHU SHALL RUN @ 100% OUTSIDE AIR
ALL EXHAUST FANS SHALL BE COMMANDED OFF
THIS SEQUENCE SHALL BE INVISIBLE TO MAINTENANCE PERSONNEL

expected_sequences.title: TOILET EXHAUST FANS - SEQUENCE OF OPERATION:
required_phrases: THE BMS SHALL INTERLOCK THE OPERATION OF THE EXHAUST FANS WITH THE OPERATION OF THE AIR HANDLING UNIT
ASSOCIATED DAMPER END SWITCH

expected_sequences.title: MECHANICAL ROOM EXHAUST FAN - SEQUENCE OF OPERATION:
required_phrases: SPACE THERMOSTAT SHALL CONTROL THE EXHAUST FAN TO MAINTAIN A ROOM TEMPERATURE OF 80 F
BOTH DAMPER END SWITCHES SENSE THAT THE DAMPERS ARE FULLY OPEN

expected_sequences.title: UNIT HEATER - SEQUENCE OF OPERATION:
required_phrases: THE LOCAL THERMOSTAT WILL MODULATE THE HEATING HOT WATER VALVE AND CYCLE ON/OFF THE UNIT HEATER FAN
PERSONNEL MANUALLY SELECT THE DESIRED HIGH, MEDIUM, OR LOW FAN SPEEDS
forbidden_phrases: HVAC CONTROLS - BMS POINT FUNCTION SCHEDULE

expected_sequences.title: FAN COIL UNIT - SEQUENCE OF OPERATION:
required_phrases: THE BMS WILL MODULATE THE HEATING HOT WATER VALVE AND CYCLE ON/OFF THE FAN COIL FAN
SET POINT OF 72 F
forbidden_phrases: HVAC CONTROLS - BMS POINT FUNCTION SCHEDULE

expected_sequences.title: DX SPLIT SYSTEM - SEQUENCE OF OPERATION:
required_phrases: WALL MOUNTED TEMPERATURE SENSOR FOR MONITORING ROOM TEMPERATURE
AN ALARM SHALL BE ACTIVATED AT THE BMS'S OWS
forbidden_phrases: HVAC CONTROLS - BMS POINT FUNCTION SCHEDULE

expected_sequences.title: FINNED TUBE RADIATOR - SEQUENCE OF OPERATION:
required_phrases: THE BMS WILL MODULATE THE HEATING HOT WATER VALVE TO MAINTAIN SPACE TEMPERATURE
FINNED TUBE RADIATION HEATING SHALL BE ACTIVATED ONLY WHEN THE OUTSIDE AIR TEMPERATURE DROPS BELOW 55 F
forbidden_phrases: HVAC CONTROLS - BMS POINT FUNCTION SCHEDULE

negative_pages.review_note: The sheet note about verifying the accuracy and adequacy of the sequence of control is a requirement, not an SOO heading.
